description: LD-01 is the primary Regional Transport Office for the Union Territory of Lakshadweep, located on the island of Kavaratti. It serves as the administrative hub for vehicle registration and licensing for the capital island and oversees transport operations across the archipelago.

The LD-02 RTO office is located on Agatti Island and serves as a key administrative hub for transport services in this part of the Union Territory. It handles vehicle registration, the issuance of driving licenses, and the collection of road taxes specifically for the Agatti region.

The LD-03 RTO is the official registration authority for the Amini island in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. It handles motor vehicle registrations, driving license issuances, and transport permits for the island's residents and transport operators.

The LD-04 RTO serves Andrott Island, the largest island in the Lakshadweep archipelago. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and the enforcement of motor vehicle regulations under the Lakshadweep Motor Vehicles Department.
address: Regional Transport Office, Androth Island, Lakshadweep

description: The LD-05 RTO office serves Kadmat Island in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. It is an active office responsible for vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and road safety enforcement for the island's residents.

The LD-06 Regional Transport Office serves the Kiltan island area in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. It is responsible for vehicle registration, road tax collection, and issuing driving licenses for the island's residents under the authority of the Sub-Divisional Officer.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer, Kiltan, Lakshadweep

description: LD-07 is the Regional Transport Office designated for Chetlat Island in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. It manages vehicle registrations under the LD-07 series, issues driving licenses, and ensures compliance with the Motor Vehicles Act across the island.
address: Regional Transport Office, Chetlat Island, Lakshadweep

description: The LD-08 RTO serves the island of Kalpeni in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. It handles vehicle registrations, driving license issuances, and road tax collection for the local residents and administration. As with other islands in the UT, registration duties are often overseen by the Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO) acting as the transport authority.
address: Sub Divisional Office, Kalpeni Island, Lakshadweep

description: LD-09 is the Regional Transport Office for Minicoy island, the southernmost atoll in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. The office is managed under the administration of the Lakshadweep Transport Department and handles all vehicle-related registrations and licensing for the local population.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer, Regional Transport Office, Minicoy, Lakshadweep
